outcome: Fetal hypoxia (measured by umbilical cord pH < 7.00)
cohort: 331,282 deliveries in Denmark, intended vaginal deliveries with liveborn singletons in cephalic presentation and gestational age ≥37 weeks, from 2009 to 2015
finding: Implementation of a national interprofessional CTG education program in Denmark was not associated with a decrease in the risk of fetal hypoxia, measured by umbilical cord pH < 7.00, 5-minute Apgar score <7 or neonatal therapeutic hypothermia.
mod_finding: Odds of emergency cesarean section were unaltered, whereas the odds of assisted vaginal delivery decreased by 14%
